title: Python: render wiki via Jinja then anthus-markus
description:
Implement Python wiki render: Jinja then anthus-markus. Add wiki render --html and extend --json with rendered_html. Wire the console/API path that serves rendered wiki HTML to this pipeline.

Requested card id kbs-357e3d was not present on this develop board; this task continues that work.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
In progress on https://github.com/AnthusAI/Kanbus/pull/226

Python `wiki render` now runs Jinja then `anthus-markus` (`markusmd.convert`). `--html` prints Markus HTML; `--json` includes `rendered_html`. Unknown `:::directives` fail with `Unknown directive`. Console/API render responses include `rendered_html`. Do not close until #226 merges. Requested id kbs-357e3d was not on this board snapshot.
